SecuritiesSettlementTransactionIdentific.name: Securities Settlement Transaction Identification
SecuritiesSettlementTransactionIdentific.definition: Unambiguous identification of the securities settlement transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingTransactionIdentifica.name: Securities Financing Transaction Identification
SecuritiesFinancingTransactionIdentifica.definition: Unambiguous identification of the underlying securities financing transaction (not the underlying securities financing trade) as assigned by the instructing party.

IntraPositionMovementIdentification.name: Intra Position Movement Identification
IntraPositionMovementIdentification.definition: Reference to the intra-position movement transaction requested to be cancelled as known by the account owner (or instructing party acting on its behalf).

OtherTransactionIdentification.name: Other Transaction Identification
OtherTransactionIdentification.definition: Reference to a transaction that cannot be identified using a standard reference element present in the message.
